blockingIssues.description: The follow-up fix moved pairwise validation into `Renumbering.__init__`, but `src/sadie/renumbering/aligners/hmmer.py:get_hmm_models()` still silently skips explicitly requested unsupported pairs whenever at least one HMM loads. Direct `HMMER(species=['alpaca'], chains=['H', 'K'])` reproduces the gap by returning only `('alpaca', 'H')` without raising, so the original HMMER-layer contract is still unmet.

nonBlockingIssues.description: The new regression tests cover only `Renumbering` with narrowed chain lists; they do not exercise the direct `HMMER(...)` mixed-request path, so the remaining escape hatch is left untested.

appliedUpdates.description: Updated `.factory/library/architecture.md` to note that `renumbering/aligners/hmmer.py` is both an internal pipeline layer and a directly exported/tested API surface, so contracts that target `HMMER.get_hmm_models()` must be enforced there as well as in `Renumbering`.
